description: No pretraining. Lite electrodes as adjacent bipolar pairs on the same shaft; line noise removed; 6 streams at 200 Hz (1-30 Hz waveform; theta, alpha, beta, low-gamma (30-70 Hz) log envelopes; 70-170 Hz high-gamma log amplitude), each normalized with median/MAD per channel over the session; every stream averaged in ten 100 ms bins over the 1 s after word onset; linear ridge readout (features z-scored on the training set, ridge regression parameters chosen on the validation AUROC). Cross-Subject: the features of each channel are averaged within its DKT atlas region.
author: Evan Chen
